as_told.title: Congressman joins the pastors' meeting by phone

plain: This story is about people from the US intelligence world quietly meeting church leaders to get them ready for news about non-human intelligence. The podcast host Jesse Michels says that around 2026 these figures were meeting pastors and religious leaders across the country and telling them to prepare their churches. A US congressman, Eric Burlison, tells it firsthand on the same episode. He says the organisers decided to gather a group of pastors and slowly bring them into the conversation to see where they stood. Burlison says he was invited to the meeting, which was held at a rented holiday home, but could not go, and offered to join by phone instead. If true, it would suggest that some insiders expect a big public announcement and want faith communities ready for it.
